lines: Sized for 8.9 MW of servers (the low end of what fits; set a size on the What fits page): heat to reject ≈ 8.9 × PUE 1.55 = 13.8 MW at peak.
12 dry coolers carry it; with spares, 13. Placed: 13 on the roof, 0 in the yard.
Each unit about 12 × 2.4 m, 2.9 m high, with 0.9–2.1 m to walls and 1.8–4.3 m between units (dashed in 3D).

Dry coolers: a 12 m V-type unit, 12 × 2.4 m, about 2.9 m high; 24.5 m² of unit per MW of heat (register: component_space, manufacturer claims), so about 1.2 MW a unit — within the 71–1,372 kW range EVAPCO lists for units up to 12 m (manufacturer claim). Clearances for V-coil units 30–40 ft long: 0.9 m end to wall, 2.1 m side to wall, 1.8 m end to end, 4.3 m side to side; the top of the unit level with or above any wall around it (EVAPCO eco-Air layout manual, 2026).
gen: 7 generator sets of about 2 MW carry 13.8 MW; with spares, 8. Placed: 0 on the roof, 4 in the yard.
Each about 13.9 × 2.7 m, 5 m high; 1.5 m from the building, 2 m between sets (assumed from the 1 m service clearance).

Standby generator sets in enclosures: about 2 MW — 13.9 × 2.7 m, up to 5.0 m high; 0.6–1 MW — up to 8.6 × 2.5 m, 3.7 m high (manufacturer data sheets, claims). 1 m clear around each set (Cummins application manual); 1.5 m from wall openings and combustible walls (NFPA 37 s. 4.1.4, a US standard; Vancouver points to CSA C282, not read).
